details: Shelah--Hodges threshold/Littlestone comparison. More precisely, $\mathrm T(\mathcal H)\geq\lfloor\log_2\mathrm L(\mathcal H)\rfloor$, which implies the displayed positive-constant logarithmic relation.
proof: Theorem 8 of the cited source gives $\mathrm T(\mathcal H)\geq\lfloor\log_2\mathrm L(\mathcal H)\rfloor$. For every positive integer $m$, $\lfloor\log_2m\rfloor\geq\tfrac12\log_2m$ (and both sides are zero for $m=1$), giving the recorded logarithmic bound.
name: Threshold Dimension / Littlestone Dimension
